overview_description.description:
YNMO is the first Arabic/English digital solution that aims to improve the quality of care and educational services for individuals with special needs by allowing service providers such as schools, centers & clinics to design and monitor individualized treatment plans.
Ynmo's mobile App also helps families screen their children through various screening tools (MCHAT - CDI - ASQ3) targeting Autism, language delay, and general developmental delay.

product.name: Ynmo Tifli
product.description: A mobile application for parents to track their child's development across motor, cognitive, linguistic, emotional, and social domains, with access to online consultations from child development specialists.

product.name: Ynmo Daycare
product.description: A comprehensive management system for childcare centers that handles enrollment, family communication, attendance tracking, and billing on a unified platform.

product.name: Ynmo Plan
product.description: A digital service for professional rehabilitation and education of children with disabilities, enabling flexible creation and management of individualized programs based on current curricula and standards.

product.name: Ynmo Assessments
product.description: A set of tools including local and international scales for professional assessment of children's skills, accompanied by customizable accredited curricula.
